performance.verdict: Spend is erratic, leads are zero, and the intake seat is empty.

findings.text: lead_drought is confirmed: 0 GHL leads recorded across all 28 days despite $1,564.56 in Google Ads spend and 15 reported conversions.
Booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 and shows no completion event — GHL automation readiness unverified while intake seat is vacant post-Vivian (left 7/7).
GBP actions collapsed to 0 for the last 4 consecutive days (Aug 15–18), following a -64.29% 7d drop; calls, directions, and web clicks all zeroed out.
Spend is highly erratic — 14 of 28 days logged $0 or under $20, with single-day spikes up to $248.50 on 7/27, suggesting budget pacing or campaign toggling instability.
GHL shows 44 opportunities created but 0 appointments and 0 lead value recorded; 78 contacts vs 0 pipeline value signals an intake processing gap, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Confirm who owns GHL intake seat post-Vivian and verify speed-to-lead automations are live before any budget increase.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian (dispatch) left 7/7 and the intake seat is unconfirmed — speed-to-lead automations may be pointing at an empty GHL login. Confirm the new owner's GHL credentials and after-hours coverage this week. 44 opportunities were created but 0 appointments booked, and 0 leads are attributed in the system despite $1,564.56 in 28-day spend. Success check: a named owner with verified GHL access and at least one test lead successfully routed by 2026-08-26.

suggestions.text: Battle-test booking bot immediately; 0 appointments in GHL confirm it has not been validated since the 7/31 deadline.
